rules.title: How it works
rules.subtitle: Short brief on how the pool runs. Enough to start betting without reading a rulebook.
rules.whatBody: A friends pool around the 2026 World Cup. Everyone predicts, points add up across the tournament, and the pot splits at the end.
rules.howBody: Open "Bets", pick a match day, then a match. Tap 1, X or 2 to drop in a default score, then tweak it with +/- for an exact prediction. There are also tournament-wide bets (champion, top scorer) and group-rankings bets.
rules.scoringRiskOffNote: Default mode: a wrong pick costs nothing. Admin can switch on "risk mode" at any time, which subtracts a penalty from your bank for wrong picks.
rules.scoringRiskOnNote: Risk mode is on: wrong picks subtract the penalty above from your bank. Admin can switch it off at any time; historical scoring is not retroactively changed.
rules.scoringExtras: Tournament bets, live bets and duels carry their own payouts, shown on each bet card.
rules.liveBody: The admin opens a fresh set of bets every matchday, priced from real bookmaker odds and normalised to our point scale. Every bet shows its stake and payout up front: get it right and you keep your stake plus the payout, get it wrong and the stake stays in the pool. Bets lock 5 minutes before kickoff.
rules.duelsBody: Any player can open a duel: a yes/no question, a stake up to the admin-configured cap, and the side you take. Another player can join and take the opposite side - both stakes lock in the bank until the match or day resolves, and the winner takes both. If nobody joins by the deadline, the duel auto-cancels and each side keeps their stake.
rules.leaderboardBody: The leaderboard splits into 4 tabs: Overall (full bank balance - King of the Mundial), Matches (best 1/X/2 picker), Live (best live-bet net), and Duels (best duel delta). Each tab has its own tie-breaker.
rules.liveViewBody: The Live scores page shows every match currently in play alongside your pick and the points you'd earn if the match ended right now. Numbers refresh themselves every 30 seconds. The final amount locks in the moment the referee blows the whistle.
rules.pagesGuideTitle: Every page in the app at a glance
rules.pagesGuideIntro: Each screen does one thing. Here is a short note on what every page is for. Come back here whenever something is unclear.
rules.transparencyBody: Every pick becomes public the moment it locks - match picks after kickoff, live bets after their lock_at, duels from creation. Filter the feed by player, category, and date.
rules.bankBody: Every player starts with {startingBank} points. Live bets and duels stake part of the bank - get it right and you keep your stake plus a payout; get it wrong and the stake stays in the pool. Match picks are mostly upside (see above). Your balance is the pill in the top header.
rules.prizesBody: A fixed setup cost is pulled off the pot first (Paybox fees, hosting, design). What remains after the deduction is what splits by the percentages below. The pot grows every time the admin approves another payment.
